blocks.text: Capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan insulating medium (bijli na guzarne dene wala madda) hota hai, is liye capacitor DC ko guzarne nahi deta. Lekin AC capacitor se guzar sakta hai. Circuit mein capacitor reactive hissa hai: resistor ke ulat, yeh AC aur DC mein alag bartao karta hai, kyunke capacitor energy ko electric field ki shakal mein jama kar sakta hai jab ke resistor kisi shakal mein energy jama nahi karta. Farz karein capacitance C wale capacitor par alternating voltage source V laga hai (Fig. 17.8(a)).

Jab capacitor ki plates par alternating voltage lagta hai to voltage ulatne ke saath capacitor pehle ek taraf aur phir doosri taraf charge hota hai. Is tarah electrons circuit mein aage peeche harkat karte hain aur alternating current banta hai. Har lamhe plates par charge q aur voltage V ka taluq q = CV rehta hai. blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Alternating current ka 'baap' kise kehte hain? Nikola Tesla 1856 mein Austria-Hungary mein paida hue aur 1884 mein physicist ke taur par America chale gaye. Unhon ne AC ki paidawar, ek jagah se doosri jagah bhejne (transmission) aur istemal ki bunyaad rakhi. AC ko DC se kahin zyada door tak bheja ja sakta hai.

Equations 17.18 aur 17.19 batati hain ke capacitor mein current I voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) aage hai, yani voltage current se 90° peeche hai (Figs. 17.8(b) aur 17.8(c)). Yaad rakhein: inductor mein iska ulat hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'inductor current I leads the voltage' likhti hai. Yeh capacitor ka hissa hai: capacitor mein current voltage se 90° aage hota hai. Inductor mein current voltage se 90° peeche hota hai (17.6).

blocks.text: Graph mein P par current sab se zyada hai jab voltage aur charge zero hain: khali capacitor sab se tezi se charge hota hai. A par voltage peak par hai aur current (N) zero. Is liye capacitor mein current voltage se 90° aage hai, inductor ke ulat.

blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'voltage in the inductor' likhti hai; sahi 'capacitor par voltage' hai.
Capacitive reactance X_C ki unit ohm hai:

Is se pata chalta hai ke kam frequency par capacitor ki reactance X_C bari hoti hai aur current kam; zyada frequency par X_C chhoti hoti hai aur usi capacitor se current zyada guzarta hai. (X_C frequency ke ulta mutabiq (inversely proportional) hai.)

blocks.prompt: 10 μF capacitor ki reactance 50 Hz aur 5 kHz par nikalein.
blocks.explanation: 50 Hz par: X_C = 1/(2 × 3.14 × 50 Hz × 10 × 10⁻⁶ F) ≈ 318 Ω. 5 kHz par: ≈ 3.18 Ω, yani sau guna kam (X_C frequency ke ulta mutabiq hai).

items: Capacitor: I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2); current voltage se 90° aage.
X_C = 1/ωC = 1/2πfC: DC (f = 0) par la-mehdood, zyada f par chhoti.
Inductor ka ulat: wahan current peeche, X_L = 2πfL.
